name: Wildcard: Holy Ascension procs from Holy Fire ticks and Ascends a Surge of Light Smite (#13110)
contract: Holy Ascension (273252) reads 'Periodic damage from Holy Fire has a 15% chance to grant Surge of Light.
Smite casts consuming Surge of Light cause you to become Ascended.' The generated DBC proc fired on any direct
magic hit and nothing granted Ascended (273269). The card now procs only on Holy Fire ticks; aura_proc_rate
replays the native decision 40000 times: about 15% for a Holy Fire tick, 0 for its direct hit and for a
Fireball. Live, a Smite without Surge of Light grants no Ascended; with Surge of Light (33151) the Smite
consumes it and grants Ascended. Removing Surge of Light while a fixture Smite is still casting must grant no
Ascended; the fixture weakens the Surge of Light cast-time modifier so the Smite has a cast bar.
